cs.label: [section] Cíl předmětu a studijní výstupy:

en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: The aim of the course is to acquaint students with basic methods and approaches to the assessment of socio-economic aspects of trees in cities. In the practical part of the course, students will process a study of the possibilities of evaluating trees in the urban area.
